entries.title: Romans 16:1
segments: ¶I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church in Cenchrea,

entries.title: Romans 16:2
segments: that you may receive her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her in whatever business she has need of you; for indeed she has been a helper of many and of myself also.

entries.title: Romans 16:3
segments: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Romans 16:4
segments: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

entries.title: Romans 16:5
segments: Likewise [greet] the church that is in their house. Greet my beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia to Christ.

entries.title: Romans 16:6
segments: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

entries.title: Romans 16:7
segments: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my countrymen and my fellow prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

entries.title: Romans 16:8
segments: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:9
segments: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

entries.title: Romans 16:10
segments: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the [household] of Aristobulus.

entries.title: Romans 16:11
segments: Greet Herodion, my countryman. Greet those who are of the [household] of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:12
segments: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, who have labored in the Lord. Greet the beloved Persis, who labored much in the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:13
segments: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

entries.title: Romans 16:14
segments: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren who are with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:15
segments: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:16
segments: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The churches of Christ greet you.

entries.title: Romans 16:17
segments: ¶Now I urge you, brethren, note those who cause divisions and offenses, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and avoid them.

entries.title: Romans 16:18
segments: For those who are such do not serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly, and by smooth words and flattering speech deceive the hearts of the simple.

entries.title: Romans 16:19
segments: For your obedience has become known to all. Therefore I am glad on your behalf; but I want you to be wise in what is good, and simple concerning evil.

entries.title: Romans 16:20
segments: And the God of peace will crush Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 16:21
segments: ¶Timothy, my fellow worker, and Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my countrymen, greet you.

entries.title: Romans 16:22
segments: I, Tertius, who wrote [this] epistle, greet you in the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:23
segments: Gaius, my host and [the host] of the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, and Quartus, a brother.

entries.title: Romans 16:24
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 16:25
segments: ¶Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery kept secret since the world began

entries.title: Romans 16:26
segments: but now has been made manifest, and by the prophetic Scriptures has been made known to all nations, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, for obedience to the faith--

entries.title: Romans 16:27
segments: to God, alone wise, [be] glory through Jesus Christ forever. Amen.
